name: Biomedical Sciences Graduate Program (BIMS)
summary: Umbrella biomedical sciences PhD at the University of Virginia. Students generally rotate with three faculty members of their choosing before selecting a mentor and thesis lab.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The Apply page says the Fall 2027 deadline is November 15, 2026 and the portal closes at 11:59pm Eastern. There is no rolling admission and no spring admission.

timeline.interviews: Competitive applicants are invited to a virtual interview session by an admission committee chair.

english.toefl: 90 for tests taken before 1/21/26; 4.5 for tests taken after 1/21/26
english.note: IELTS minimum is 7.0 in each section. Most international students must submit TOEFL, IELTS or DET scores; TOEFL is not required with a U.S. undergraduate or Master's degree, and can be waived with verification of institutional language instruction. Official scores are required only if the applicant matriculates; scores are valid for two years.

applicationFee.note: The page words the $85 non-refundable fee as due for "Fall 2025 admission", so confirm the current amount. It links waivers for domestic applicants and says: "We are not currently offering fee waivers to International applicants."

documents: Unofficial transcripts of entire post-secondary record (English translation if needed)
requirements.note: GREs are no longer considered. Applicants are expected to have a minimum GPA of 3.0. Final official transcripts are required before matriculation. All three letters must be in before the deadline or the application is not reviewed.

funding.note: The Funding page says all students receive tuition, health/dental insurance and a competitive stipend, but gives no amount and does not mention international students. Continued support depends on full-time enrollment and satisfactory progress.
